verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals has on-call schedules and rotations, and its changelog announces 'Preserved OnCall Schedule Overrides', which implies schedule overrides exist as a first-party feature. The evidence is a single changelog headline. It does not show that an on-call engineer can create an override themselves, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin editing the schedule. Missing for 10: documented self-service override workflow, shift-swap capability, coverage-request flow, permission model showing non-admin engineers can do this, hands-on corroboration.
